name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
summary: Beneath Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, a Scarlet Zealot is held captive. Forsaken apothecaries use him to test concoctions for the Royal Apothecary Society.

sections.title: A Bitter Captive in Brill
sections.body:
Beneath Gallows' End Tavern, a Scarlet Crusade zealot sits chained and defiant. He keeps his faith and calls the undead around him abominations. He calls on the Light to shield him from his captors.

The Forsaken hold him for Apothecary Johaan. As a living human, he is valuable to the apothecary, who tests the lethality of experimental plagues and toxins under development.

faq.q: Why is a Scarlet Zealot kept alive in Brill?
aliases: who is the zealot in brill cellar
faq.answer: The Forsaken keep him captive beneath Gallows' End Tavern as a living human test subject. The Royal Apothecary Society is developing the poisons and chemical agents tested on him.

faq.q: Where can I find this captive?
faq.answer: He is held in the cellar beneath Gallows' End Tavern, in the center of Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: How does he react to the Forsaken around him?
faq.answer: He remains fanatically defiant in captivity. He calls on the Light to protect him from his undead captors and swears the Scarlet Crusade will rid Azeroth of them.

angles.text: To Brill's Forsaken, this chained fanatic represents the crusaders who seek their extermination. They use him as test material for an apothecary.
Scarlet zealots claim the Holy Light for their own. Yet this prisoner's unwavering faith offers no defense against Forsaken captivity.
